source.name: Torino FC, 'Beretta è Sleeve Partner della Prima squadra'
source.quote: siamo felici di accogliere ancora una volta Salumificio Fratelli Beretta al nostro fianco come Sleeve Partner per la stagione 2026/27
source.note: Translation: 'we are happy to welcome Salumificio Fratelli Beretta once again at our side as Sleeve Partner for the 2026/27 season.' Deal value not disclosed. Beretta was Torino's Second Main Partner in 2024/25 (club third-kit announcement, 2 October 2024: 'Fratelli Beretta as Second Main Partner... JD as Sleeve Partner') and JD Sports was the Sleeve Partner in 2025/26 (club announcement quoted by Economia e Sport, 4 July 2025), so the sleeve placement starts with the 2026-27 season.

note: The club's announcement quotes president Vittore Beretta: 'Siamo orgogliosi di ritornare sulla maglia della Prima Squadra del Toro' ('We are proud to return to the shirt of the Toro first team').
